summary: Frontend-only verification of new Select all / Deselect all controls across 5 list views. All wiring works correctly: select-all checks all visible items, deselect clears state and hides action buttons, select-all reflects full-selection state (unchecked on partial), no native confirm() dialog appears, and a real bulk delete on Forms removed 1 item (282->281) with success toast '1 Deleted'. No console errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: useSelection.toggleAll: `s.size >= ids.length && ids.length > 0 ? new Set() : new Set(ids)` — behaves correctly for observed cases; edge case: if user manually selects an item that was later removed from the list (stale id in set), size could equal current ids.length and clicking select-all would clear instead of selecting all. Low risk given current UX.
select-all controls are hidden entirely when a list is empty (Messages, AI Assistant with 0 items). Consider whether that is desired UX (matches spec 'appears when items exist').
seed_data_creation: Deleted 1 pre-existing TEST_UB_big form as part of bulk-delete verification (282 -> 281 forms). No new records were created; Messages and AI Assistant had 0 records so their select-all UI could not be exercised at runtime, but code review confirms identical wiring (data-testid=select-all-messages/select-all-chats, deselect-messages/deselect-chats).

Results per page: Appointments 7/7 select+deselect OK, sa unchecks on partial then rechecks all; Notes 1/1 OK; Forms 282/282 OK plus real bulk-delete (282->281) with success toast, no confirm dialog; Messages and AI Assistant currently have 0 items — controls correctly hidden.
